page_title: WHU 4-2 BRE | West Ham v Brentford 26/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' Brentford take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+6' Superb touch by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) as he receives a precise pass into the box, but the goalkeeper stops the ball as it heads towards the top of the net. Brilliant save! Brentford will take a corner kick.
90+6' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

90+5' Alphonse Areola makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Ivan Toney (Brentford) after a cross from the side. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
90+4' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) comes onto the pitch so that Mohammed Kudus can be given a rest.
90+4' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the corner which is cleared.

90+3' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Christian Norgaard (Brentford) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. It will be a corner kick for Brentford.
90+2' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is booked.
88' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) tries to find Ivan Toney, but he puts too much power on the pass.
87' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
86' It could have been a good chance to score! Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) fails to release Yoane Wissa with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
85' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
84' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Simon Hooper signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Brentford players celebrate.
83' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Brentford players aren’t happy.
82' 4 - 2 Goal! Mikkel Damsgaard tees up Yoane Wissa (Brentford) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 4:2.
79' Ivan Toney (Brentford) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
77' The ball ricochets out to Zanka (Brentford) and he blasts a first-time shot towards goal from inside the box, but the effort flies high over the bar.
77' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Mathias Jensen is replaced by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford).
76' Today's match ends for Lucas Paqueta who will be replaced by Michail Antonio (West Ham).
75' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola is equal to it and makes an easy save.

74' A neat pass is well received by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
74' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) replaces Frank Onyeka.
73' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Sergio Reguilon will be replaced by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
73' That will be all from Neal Maupay who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Yoane Wissa (Brentford).
72' 16:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 5:3.

69' 4 - 1 Emerson (West Ham) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the top right corner. He makes it 4:1 with this magnificent strike.
67' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
67' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

66' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the bottom left corner. Alphonse Areola is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.

63' 3 - 1 Mohammed Kudus produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 3:1.
63' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
62' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Now West Ham have a corner.
61' Nathan Michael Collins comes onto the pitch because Ben Mee (Brentford) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
59' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

58' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
57' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Alphonse Areola.
54' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
53' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Simon Hooper signals. West Ham are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
52' Zanka (Brentford) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
51' Ben Mee (Brentford) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Ben Mee (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Neal Maupay (Brentford) brings his opponent down. Simon Hooper has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. West Ham have been awarded a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Ivan Toney (Brentford) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
45+2' The free kick is taken by Sergio Reguilon (Brentford), but ball is cleared.

45+1' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Simon Hooper blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Brentford.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) wins the ball from the resulting free kick but scuffs his shot well wide of the left post! The referee stops play as the linesman flags Tomas Soucek (West Ham) offside.
45' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) trips an opposition player and Simon Hooper signals a foul. A free kick to West Ham.

41' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box. Emerson plays a lofted ball into Tomas Soucek (West Ham) near the penalty spot, but the ball flies off the top of his head and goes high over the bar.
41' Neal Maupay (Brentford) is penalised for holding. Simon Hooper signals a set piece. West Ham earn a free kick.
38' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.

37' What a poor attempt! Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
37' A cross into the box from Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is cleared.
33' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Mark Flekken is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
33' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
32' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a low pass from outside the box to Mohammed Kudus. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment.
30' The total number of attempts is 8:1. 2:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
28' Zanka (Brentford) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
27' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
26' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
26' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) takes a short corner kick.
25' Ivan Toney (Brentford) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brentford.
24' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
23' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) for his blatant foul.
22' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) receives a reproachful look from Edson Alvarez. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the right post.
21' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Mark Flekken scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
20' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
19' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) jumps into a tackle and Simon Hooper signals a foul.
17' Vladimir Coufal beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Lucas Paqueta (West Ham), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
16' One of the players from Brentford times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
15' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.

13' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Keane Lewis-Potter, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Neal Maupay (Brentford), who beats Alphonse Areola with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 2:1.
12' Zanka (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
10' Emerson (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
9' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Alphonse Areola comes off his line to gather the ball.
7' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Vladimir Coufal tees up Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Mark Flekken.
5' 1 - 0 Emerson plays a neat ball into the path of Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the left post! 1:0.
4' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just over the bar.
3' Emerson (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
2' There's a distinct lack of options for Mohammed Kudus (West Ham), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brentford will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper will referee today's match.
